title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-12-01

ai_review.summary: Terrible audience recording of the 1973 show, yet the Playin'>Uncle John's>Playin' jam shines through.
ai_review.review: Listeners lament the muddy, crowd‑filled AUD source, calling it almost unlistenable, but several fans note that the Playin'>Uncle John's>Playing sequence is a standout moment worthy of an SBD release. Aside from that highlight, no other performance aspects are praised, and the overall listening experience is hampered by poor sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers criticize the recording quality (audience source, muffled, crowd‑heavy) while only one specific performance moment is praised; this yields a low overall rating despite a single musical highlight.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audible but extremely crowd‑heavy, muffled and distorted; reviewers describe it as 'awful', 'horrid audience' and overall unlistenable without a better source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed commentary on set pacing; only the Playin'>Uncle John's>Playing segment is highlighted as a high point.
